This is the exercise booklet for **Module 3** of the Health Data Science MSc.
It is organised by teaching day. Each day has its own page, and each exercise
inside a day is something you can finish in a single sitting.

**Each exercise is code to read and copy.** The worked examples are shown with
the output they produce, so you can compare your own result against ours. You
run the code in R or Python on your own machine or vlab. Every exercise has an
R path and a Python path doing the same work; in class we go through R most of
the time.

A day appears here when it has been released.
